home.subtitle: Test file generator
home.headline: Test the limits. Without uploading anything.
home.description: Configure an exact-size file and create it directly in your browser.

search.prompt: What file type do you want to generate?

form.sizeHelp: We use decimal MB: 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes. For example, 10 MB may appear in Linux as approximately 9.5 MiB.
form.sizeHelpShort: We use decimal MB: 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes.
form.filenameHelp: Only letters, accented letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores. The extension is added automatically.

largeFileDialog.title: Large file
largeFileDialog.description: Generating very large files (>500MB) may consume a lot of RAM and slow down your browser. Are you sure?

privacy.title: Local processing
privacy.description: BlobSpawn generates the file directly in your browser using your computer's resources. Speed depends on your device's performance and available memory. We do not upload your parameters or the file to any server; the download is created from a temporary Blob and released when complete.

security.enableHelp: Disabled by default. PDF restrictions depend on the reader and are not DRM.
security.restrictionsHelp: Checked boxes restrict the indicated capability. Accessibility, signing, page extraction, and templates may depend on the standard and the reader.
security.accessibilityWarning: Warning: modern PDFs usually allow this extraction even if you enable the restriction. Blocking cannot be guaranteed.

restrictions.contentCopying: Extracción o copia de contenido / Content copying or extraction
restrictions.accessibilityExtraction: Extracción de contenido para accesibilidad / Content extraction for accessibility
restrictions.formFilling: Cumplimentar campos de formulario / Filling of form fields
restrictions.templatePages: Creación de páginas de plantilla / Creation of template pages

fields.jsonKeyDescription: Used as a simple key inside the generated object.

fields.csvHeaderDescription: One ASCII column. Rows use the same number of fields.

fields.pageCountDescription: Between 1 and 1,000 pages. Each page contains an image and text.
fields.pdfTextDescription: Plain text, max 500 characters and 2,000 UTF-8 bytes.
